Compares (SKILL.md documents produced by two optimizers, GEPA and SkillOpt, vs an empty seed SKILL, same agent and model, three Kotlin repositories); secondary: proposes an evaluation method (reverse-PR task mining at a single frozen base commit + paired rollout objective)

Not an SDD approach. Repository SKILL (single SKILL.md loaded into agent context, agentskills.io / Anthropic SKILL spec), synthesized automatically by GEPA (Agrawal et al., 2025; 200 scored attempts) and SkillOpt (Yang et al., 2026; 3 epochs). Versions Not stated

Automatic: hidden tests in per-repo Docker images, paired comparison of rollouts (test-file edits/false claims, F2P, then fraction passed, honesty, diff size, tool calls), sign test. Manual: one maintainer reviewed SKILLs and anonymized patches

Agent: Claude Code + Sonnet 4.6 (frozen) for all. Criterion: paired score vs empty-seed rollout on held-out split (0.5 = no change) and resolved tasks.

- Rejected objectives (preliminary tracy sweep, Table 3-4): binary resolve, gold match, token price, judge, file scores; most shipped no file or overfit

Tasks: reverse-PR mined tasks per repository split once into train/validation/test; GEPA 200 scored attempts, SkillOpt 3 epochs on same splits. Configurations: empty seed, GEPA SKILL, SkillOpt SKILL. Baseline: empty SKILL. Held constant: agent (Claude Code), model (Sonnet 4.6), tools, limits, Docker image, frozen base without .git. Acceptance tests: hidden FAIL_TO_PASS tests + up to 30 regression guards. Repetitions: seed run once per task; one candidate rollout per task. Human intervention: none

GEPA +4.9 pp mean (wins on all 3 repos); SkillOpt +0.1 pp (loss on ktor cancels gains). Not significant: best sign test p = 0.29; at 20-26 tasks detectable only if document wins 4 of 5 disagreements (2 of 3 pooled over 69). Maintainer would take GEPA SKILL 'as a draft'; with either SKILL live issues solved in under half the time and at lower cost (2 issues, single runs). Total optimization spend $2,013.98, 69.2 h

No (on the score): paired metric could not separate gains from agent run-to-run variance at feasible split sizes; reverse mining at frozen base fixed stale-claim SKILLs from forward mining. Limitations stated: few tasks per repository, cost per rollout, LLM reverter defects (static check rejected 56 of 280), single maintainer

At least 100 graded tasks needed and still too few for significance; two repositories (tracy, http4k) failed to reach the floor; LLM reverter introduces defects; one maintainer of one repository; Kotlin only. Future: cheaper rollouts, evaluation not based on pass rate, developer study with many reviewers
